tasks.short: Provide advice on carriers and shipping routes

steps.what: Open transportation options and the carriers
Provide advice from the stored shipping routes
Choose types of carriers the table omits
Send the route advice the broker chose

tasks.design: Contracted transportation options are opened from {ERP}: carrier, route, and price. Advice is that table, not a guessed route. The broker chooses when the table has no lane, and the advice is sent only after that choice.
tasks.previous_blocker: Routes were compared in a side sheet of rates that had been mailed in.
tasks.enabler_now: Contracted lanes are stored, so a known lane is a lookup.
tasks.still_hard: A lane that is not contracted, and the choice among types of carrier, stay with the broker.
tasks.human_edge: The broker chooses the route that is sent.

ambition.what: A shipment on a contracted lane gets its options the day it is asked, and the broker still chooses.

tasks.altitude: The broker sees the contracted lanes before choosing.

reach.learn: Which carrier and route were offered.

evidence.claim: Route advice is a stored table of contracted lanes, and the broker chooses what is sent. The source pack says duty and tax figures are configured from a public tariff and contracted rates, and that a classification is taken from a stored binding decision only when one matches, with the broker signing the code.

The source pack says a solely automated decision with a significant effect on a person needs a human review. A duty figure here is a stored rate times a stored value, and the broker signs before a filing, a payment, or a quote leaves. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when a shipment needs a carrier or a route and ends when the broker has chosen the advice to send.
A lane has origin, destination, carrier, and price, maintained by the broker from the contract. A pair with no lane is not given a price by the table.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the broker's effort.
A missing rate, code, or document is not invented. The broker does that part.
The incremental hour updates the record when its source row changes.
unknowns: How often the contracted table covers the lanes this book of work actually uses.
research_questions: Which shipments had no contracted lane?

already_counted.description: The checking time is already in the broker's step.

incremental.description: Update the opened record when its source row changes.

approvals.approved_version: route the broker chose for that shipment

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The saving counts lanes that are already contracted and stored. An unknown lane is chosen by the broker, and the choice stays.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Insure cargo against loss, damage, or pilferage

steps.what: Open the cargo value and the route
Insure cargo against damage or pilferage
Note damage the cover does not insure

tasks.design: Cargo value and route are opened from {ERP}. The broker insures the cargo against damage or pilferage with the insurer, by {TELEPHONY}, and the cover is stored in {CLM}. Risks the cover does not take stay noted. The system does not place cover.
tasks.previous_blocker: The value was read to the insurer from a sheet, and the cover note came back by mail.
tasks.enabler_now: The value and the route are on the shipment, so the broker does not retype them for the insurer.
tasks.still_hard: The insurer's terms, and whether this cargo should be covered, stay with the broker.
tasks.altitude: The broker sees the cargo value before placing cover.

reach.learn: Which cargo and which risks are covered.

evidence.claim: The cargo record can be opened, and placing the cover stays with the broker. The source pack says duty and tax figures are configured from a public tariff and contracted rates, and that a classification is taken from a stored binding decision only when one matches, with the broker signing the code.

The source pack says a solely automated decision with a significant effect on a person needs a human review. A duty figure here is a stored rate times a stored value, and the broker signs before a filing, a payment, or a quote leaves. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when cargo needs cover against damage or pilferage and ends when the broker has placed the cover or refused it.
The shipment has cargo id, value, and route, produced by the order. A cargo id with no value is not given a cover amount by the system.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the broker's effort.
A missing rate, code, or document is not invented. The broker does that part.
The incremental hour updates the record when its source row changes.
unknowns: Whether the insurer accepts a request that starts from the shipment record.
research_questions: Which cargo is still without cover?

already_counted.description: The checking time is already in the broker's step.

incremental.description: Update the opened record when its source row changes.

approvals.approved_version: cover the broker is placing for that cargo

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The saving is not retyping a value that is already stored. Placing the cover stays with the broker.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Maintain relationships with customs brokers in other ports

steps.what: Open customs brokers at the other ports
Note cargo the other port is not clearing

tasks.design: Names and ports of other brokers are opened from {DOCS}. The broker maintains the relationship by {TELEPHONY} or in person, so cargo can be cleared faster. The note records the cargo id that is waiting, not a score of the other broker.
tasks.previous_blocker: The other broker's name lived in a mailbox, and the cargo they were clearing was easy to lose.
tasks.enabler_now: The contact and the port are stored, so the call starts from the right person and the right cargo.
tasks.still_hard: The relationship itself, and whether that port will expedite a clearance, stay a conversation.
tasks.human_edge: The broker decides which cargo is still not clearing.
tasks.altitude: The broker sees the port contact before the call, and nobody is scored.

reach.learn: Which cargo is waiting at that port.

evidence.claim: A contact list can be opened, and the relationship stays with the broker. The source pack says duty and tax figures are configured from a public tariff and contracted rates, and that a classification is taken from a stored binding decision only when one matches, with the broker signing the code.

The source pack says a solely automated decision with a significant effect on a person needs a human review. A duty figure here is a stored rate times a stored value, and the broker signs before a filing, a payment, or a quote leaves. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when cargo needs a broker at another port and ends when the broker has spoken to them and noted what is still waiting.
A contact has port id, name, and channel, maintained by the broker. Cargo with no port id is not assigned to a contact by the list.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the broker's effort.
A missing rate, code, or document is not invented. The broker does that part.
The incremental hour updates the record when its source row changes.
unknowns: Whether the other broker will act on a cargo id sent from this record.
research_questions: Which cargo is still waiting at another port?

already_counted.description: The checking time is already in the broker's step.

incremental.description: Update the opened record when its source row changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The saving is finding a contact that is already stored. The relationship and the clearance stay with people, and no broker is scored.
